Confirm conditional features before testing them. Any implementation requires a separate improvement plan and authorization.
audit.md:98: Review again when these evidence gaps can be closed, before expanding access or claiming launch readiness. No operating state file or launch acceptance is required to complete this offline audit.
Audit handoff does not require setup activity. Implementation is explicitly a later separately authorized improvement.
